modules.name: shell-nav + ShellStore
modules.responsibility: Holds which workspace view is active and what object is selected, enforcing the view-switch-clears-selection invariant in one pure reducer with a thin rune wrapper.
modules.notes: ShellStore is a near 1:1 forwarder over shell-nav; the one piece of real state it owns alone is `liveRouting`, a Patch-view-published side channel that doesn't belong to navigation.

modules.name: AuthorShell (app shell layout)
modules.responsibility: Composes top bar, transport, left rail, center workspace view and right column into the resizable shell and reconciles selection against the engine store as the active song/section/graph move.
modules.notes: Overlays is a 3-line pass-through mount point. AuthorShell holds a non-obvious $effect bridging shell selection to engine state — the kind of coupling worth a lens.

modules.name: Patch routing model
modules.responsibility: Pure translation between the project's OutputConfig list and the Patch graph's Output→Hoop chain routing, including pixel-span math, signatures and default routing synthesis.
modules.notes: Real algorithmic content behind a modest interface. Signature-string functions hint at change-detection by stringification.

modules.name: Patch topology + zone layout
modules.responsibility: Builds the Patch graph's node/edge structure — stages, id encoding, container zones, auto-fit, persisted layout adoption, and connection classification.
modules.notes: Two overlapping id vocabularies exist (patch-topology's hoopId/outputId vs patch-graph's hoopNodeId/outputNodeId) — a likely lens target.

modules.name: Patch graph view
modules.responsibility: Renders the physical rig as an xyflow container graph, reads rewires back into routing, persists manual layout, and publishes live routing to the shell.
modules.notes: ~395 LOC of orchestration in one component: derivation, signature comparison, mount/destroy lifecycle, persistence.

modules.name: Trigger graph view
modules.responsibility: Renders the active section's trigger graph on xyflow with wiring validation, splice-on-drop, alignment guides, lint strip and the Node Editor drawer.
modules.notes: TriggerGraphView at 746 LOC is the largest component in scope and the densest interaction hub.

modules.name: Graph canvas kit (shared xyflow substrate)
modules.responsibility: The one deduplicated SvelteFlow setup (background, controls, fit, theming, wiring events) plus the geometric helpers both graph views share.
modules.notes: This is the intended seam between the two graph views; worth checking whether both views actually route everything through it.

modules.name: Graph projection + lint
modules.responsibility: Projects the domain TriggerGraph into xyflow nodes/edges with signature-based incremental caching, and turns core render-plan issues into per-node lint entries.

modules.name: Add palette / node taxonomy
modules.responsibility: Defines the catalog of addable node kinds/presets, its search/filter/drag encoding, and the shared select-option constants used by every inspector.
modules.notes: node-options.ts is a constants bag plus formatting helpers — two unrelated responsibilities in one file.

modules.name: Inspector dispatcher
modules.responsibility: Resolves the current selection to a node or patch object and dispatches to the correct per-kind inspector, owning only the shared header chrome and read-only fieldset.
modules.notes: Inspector.svelte is a 307-line if/else-if ladder over ~22 kinds — a repeated-switch candidate. patch-inspector.ts is separately deep (pixel math, input-map mutation).

modules.name: Trigger node inspectors
modules.responsibility: One form editor per trigger-graph node kind, mutating the engine store through its public mutators.
modules.notes: Thirteen sibling forms with the same prop shape and near-identical row markup; scope-inspector.ts is the one with real logic.

modules.name: Patch object inspectors + controller status
modules.responsibility: Editors for physical rig objects plus the live output/controller confidence panels driven by server status messages.
modules.notes: ControllerStatusPanel is 847 LOC — the single largest file in scope, presentational but huge. output-status.ts is a bag of ~15 tiny formatters.

modules.name: Sections view
modules.responsibility: Arranges a song's sections and their graph placements as drag-and-droppable columns over the pure setlist transform functions.
modules.notes: setlist.ts is a clean immutable-transform module; recall.ts is a tiny naming-convention module.

modules.name: Objects view
modules.responsibility: Browsable index of every authored object type (songs, library, effects, graphs, presets, canvas scenes) with per-type row projections.
modules.notes: Six *Row components and six *Rows projection functions with parallel shapes — a duplication lens should start here.

modules.name: Clipboard dialogs
modules.responsibility: Modal surfaces for pasting copied songs/graphs/sections when the browser clipboard read is unavailable or a destination choice is needed.
modules.notes: Confirmed by whitespace-stripped diff: the two dialogs are structurally the same file with one extra destination control.

modules.name: Chrome (top bar, rails, transport)
modules.responsibility: Persistent app chrome — navigation rails, transport controls, save/link status indicators and the settings/IO dialogs reachable from them.

modules.name: Show/share/backup chrome
modules.responsibility: Show selection, viewer-share link surfacing with its visibility gate, PIN entry, and backup snapshot browsing/restore.
modules.notes: share-gating.ts is a single 3-argument boolean — a guard worth a fail-closed lens.

modules.name: Desktop bridge + boot
modules.responsibility: Adapts the optional Tauri desktop host (boot events, tunnel state, updates) into a reactive boot status and the overlays/badges that render it.
modules.notes: Cleanly seamed: pure reducer + adapter interface + reactive class. The module-level `desktopBridge` singleton is the notable global.

modules.name: Monitor dock
modules.responsibility: Ring-buffered live event log with type/text filtering, rendered as the Monitor workspace view.

modules.name: Layers / visualizer / perform docks
modules.responsibility: Right-column bus/layer mixer, 3D kit preview, the chrome-light performance surface, and the graph list rail.

modules.name: Keyboard shortcuts
modules.responsibility: Parses shortcut combos, matches keyboard events against a registry, and dispatches with editable-target suppression and platform-aware modifier handling.

modules.name: Error capture
modules.responsibility: Installs window.onerror / unhandledrejection / console.error hooks that funnel browser errors into an injectable sink and returns an uninstall function.

modules.name: Screenshot seam (dev-only)
modules.responsibility: Exposes window.__LEDRUMS_SHOT__, a scripted driver that puts the app into arbitrary named states for the ui-shot capture tool.
modules.notes: A very wide interface over thin forwarding calls; must track every store API it drives, so it is a natural drift point.

modules.name: Transient UI preview singletons
modules.responsibility: Module-level rune singletons holding ephemeral drag/hover/lint preview state shared between a view and its child nodes.
modules.notes: Five near-identical tiny classes exported as module singletons — global mutable UI state outside any component tree.

modules.name: Trigger source labelling
modules.responsibility: Turns a TriggerSource plus the input map into human labels and the cross-links between a graph, a drum and a zone.

seams.why: Deliberately extracted shared SvelteFlow substrate, generic over node/edge types — behaviour common to both graph views can be changed here without touching either view.
The Tauri host is behind an injectable interface with a pure reducer, so desktop behaviour is swappable/testable without a desktop build.
Sink and environment are both injected; error routing changes without editing the capture logic.
Navigation transitions are pure functions the rune store merely forwards to, so the invariant can be changed in one tested place.
Meant to be a thin dispatcher, but the if/else ladder also owns per-kind header chrome and icon choices, so adding a node kind requires editing the dispatcher as well as the new inspector.
Thirteen sibling forms share a prop contract and row layout by convention only — no inspector-shell primitive, so a change to inspector chrome means thirteen edits.
Six object-row components and six parallel row-projection functions with no shared row abstraction; a new object type is a copy-paste of both halves.
A dev-only seam over the store that must be updated in lockstep with every store/shell API it drives; it can silently drift from the UI it claims to mirror.
PatchGraphView publishes live routing into the navigation store so the Inspector can read it — a back-channel that couples three modules through global-ish state rather than a declared interface.
Module-level mutable singletons let any component alter drag/lint/hover presentation from anywhere, with no ownership or reset contract.
A single pure predicate gates whether the viewer share link is exposed — one place to change the policy, and the obvious place to check it fails closed.

seams.at: apps/web/src/lib/app/patch-topology.ts id helpers vs patch-graph.ts node-id helpers
seams.why: Two coexisting encodings for the same node identities mean the id vocabulary can be changed in one file and silently disagree with the other.
Re-projection is gated entirely by string signatures, so incremental-update behaviour is tunable in one module — and also fails there if a signature omits a field.

suspicions.hunch: A whitespace-stripped diff shows the two files are the same dialog modulo one destination SegmentedControl; PatchDiffDialog may be a third member of the family.
Same prop shape, same header/row scaffolding repeated per node kind; likely the bulk of the jscpd clone count in this scope.

suspicions.where: apps/web/src/lib/app/views/SongRow.svelte, LibrarySongRow, LibraryRefRow, GraphRow, EffectRow, PresetRow, CanvasSceneRow
suspicions.hunch: Seven row components plus six parallel *Rows() projections in objects-view.ts look like one row abstraction copied per object type.

A 307-line if/else-if ladder over node kind is likely mirrored by kind switches in trigger-node-meta.ts (kindIcon/kindLabel/tint) and node-options.ts KIND_OPTS — adding a kind probably means editing four places.
746 LOC combining projection, wiring validation, splice geometry, drag-and-drop from the palette, lint and drawer state — several unrelated reasons to change one file.
847 LOC in one 'presentational' component covering identity, discovery/adoption, per-universe rx, health and test patterns; each is a separate change axis.
Live patch routing is smuggled through the navigation store as a publish/subscribe back-channel; the long apologetic comment suggests it papers over a missing model boundary.
Node identity is stringly-typed with several parallel prefix schemes (hoop:/zone:/drum:/output:/trigger:) plus separate parsers in patch-graph.ts; mismatched encodings would fail only at runtime.
Change detection across several modules is done by concatenated strings; a field omitted from a signature yields a stale view with no error.
Overlays is a bare three-component mount; ShellStore forwards nearly every method straight to shell-nav — both may be pass-throughs earning little.
A 540-line dev-only interface with ~40 ops; some ops may be unreferenced by any ui-shot preset and simply carried along.
Both are large bags of exported constants/formatters; knip's 73 issues plausibly cluster here as unused exports.
pixelsPerHoopForDrum / perHoopPixelCount / hoopPixelSpan all take the same (drum, kit, …) tuple, suggesting a missing hoop-geometry value object.
Viewer-share exposure hinges on one boolean derived from boot stage; worth checking it fails closed on unknown/transitional stages.
The comment describes a past race where a transiently-null selectedGraph cleared the selection; the current guard may still have untreated interleavings.
Global mutable UI state shared across component trees with no reset ownership; stale preview state could survive a view switch.

items.coverage_notes: Read fully or substantially: shell-nav.ts, shell-store.svelte.ts, AuthorShell.svelte (script + top of markup), Overlays.svelte, Inspector.svelte (head), and the export surfaces of every non-test .ts / .svelte.ts file in scope (app root, chrome/, docks/, docks/inspectors/, views/). Read the header comments of the largest Svelte components (TriggerGraphView, PatchGraphView, GraphCanvas, ControllerStatusPanel, shot-seam). Did NOT read the bodies of most .svelte files — component LOC, responsibilities and grouping for those are inferred from filenames, imports, header comments and line counts, so per-component depth judgements (especially in the inspectors and Objects-view row families) are informed guesses rather than verified. Test files were listed but not read, so I cannot speak to test quality or coverage per module. I did not verify which knip issues or jscpd clones fall in which module — the dead-code and duplication suspicions name likely clusters, not confirmed hits. The only duplication claim I actually verified is PasteSongDialog vs PasteFallbackDialog (whitespace-stripped diff). External dependencies (trigger-lab store, ui/ primitives, ws/protocol-types, @ledrums/core) are outside scope and were not opened, so 'depends_on' names them without describing their surfaces.
